ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION is declared in the manifest, but no Android location APIs are called at runtime. The only 'getLocation()' method refers to in-game object position, not device geolocation. No UI mention or justification for location access.
READ_PHONE_STATE is declared (twice) in the manifest, but there is no evidence of phone state API usage at runtime, nor any UI mention or justification.
